Preface Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0) has been launched with an objective to provide pucca houses to 1 crore people of urban India. The Scheme emphasizes empowerment of urban poor and middle-class families by giving them secured pucca houses to focus on the betterment of their lives. PMAY-U 2.0 will provide financial assistance to 1 crore families to construct, purchase or rent a house in urban areas over a period of 5 years. Government Assistance of ₹2.30 lakh crore will be provided under the Scheme. Families belonging to EWS/LIG/MIG segments, having no pucca house anywhere in the country, are eligible to purchase or construct a house under PMAY-U 2.0. The Scheme will be implemented through different verticals, giving eligible beneficiaries the option avail benefits under any one of the four verticals as per their choice and eligibility. A unified web portal has been developed to effectively execute the Scheme. It also ensures transparency, helps in monitoring and efficient management of the Scheme and more importantly, to enable beneficiaries to directly apply under PMAY-U 2.0. The portal simplifies the process for application, allows beneficiaries to know the status of application, modalities of data exchange among stakeholders, ensures faster due diligence, approval and release of subsidy. The web portal is accessible to all stakeholders and will help in monitoring and evaluating of PMAY-U 2.0 scheme. The user manual will help the beneficiaries and all stakeholders with the web portal and will guide them on how to use it effectively. It will take the users through the portal's features, sections, and tools to ensure smooth implementation. Table of Contents S. No Particular Page No. 1 Background 6 2 Coverage 7 3 Eligibility Criteria 8 4 PMAY-U 2.0 Verticals 9 5 Flowchart 9-12 • Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC) 9 • Affordable Rental Housing (ARH) 10-11 • Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS) 12 6 User Manual- Beneficiary Survey Application 13-34 PMAY-U 2.0 MIS 12 • Applying for PMAY-U 2.0 14 • Documents Required 15 • Eligibility Criteria 16 • Aadhar Authentication 17 7 Filling the Beneficiary survey form 18-27 • BLC Component 18 • AHP Component 23 • ISS Component 27 8 Submitting the survey form 35 9 Applicant Login 36-37 Things To Know 1. A beneficiary meeting the eligibility criteria defined under the scheme may submit the application through Unified Web Portal of PMAY-U 2.0, Common Service Centre (CSC) or by visiting the concerned Urban Local Bodies/Municipalities they are residing in. 2. A 'Pucca' house is defined as an all-weather dwelling unit with roof and walls made up of sturdy, modern, and durable materials like burnt bricks, stones packed with cement or lime, cement concrete, timber, Galvanized Iron (GI) sheets, asbestos sheets, machine-made tiles etc. 3. A beneficiary family will comprise of husband, wife, unmarried sons and/or unmarried daughters. User must fill the details of all family members with Aadhar Details, Date of Birth, Relationship with Beneficiary and Occupation. 4. In case of a married male, details of wife should be included; and in case of unmarried children, their details should be included. 5. EWS households are defined as households with an annual income up to ₹3 lakh. LIG households are households with an annual income from ₹3 lakh up to ₹6 lakh. MIG households are households with an annual income from ₹6 lakh up to ₹9 lakh. 6. The present address is the current location where the applicant is residing at the time of registration. 7. Permanent address is the official and long-term residence of the applicant as per the legal or official documents. 8. The construction site address is the location where the housing construction or the proposed site of construction under PMAY-U 2.0. 9. List of Other Government schemes under which applicants could have availed benefits: National Health Mission (NHM), Ayushman Bharat, Swachch Bharat Mission - Urban (SBM-U) 2.0, Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM), PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY), Unnat Jyoti by Affordable LEDs for All (Ujala), Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT). 10. PMAY-U 2.0 also focusses on special groups such as Safai Karmi, Street Vendors identified under Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PMSVANidhi) Scheme and different artisans under Pradhan Mantri-Vishwakarma Scheme, Anganwadi Workers, Building and other Construction Workers (BoCW), slum dwellers/chawls and other groups identified during operation of the scheme. 10. Preference under the scheme will also be given to widows, Persons with Disabilities, transgenders, persons belonging to Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes, and Minorities. 6 Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban 2.0 – ‘Housing for All’ Mission will be implemented for 5 years to provide financial assistance to 1 crore urban poor and middle-class families through States/Union Territories (UTs)/Primary Lending Institutions (PLIs) to construct, purchase or rent a house at an affordable cost in urban areas. PMAY-U, launched in June 2015, is one of the major flagship programmes of Government of India to provide all-weather pucca houses to all eligible beneficiaries in the urban areas. Based on the learnings gathered during the implementation of the PMAY-U Scheme and, also to meet the housing requirements arising out of the increase in the number of eligible families, the Union Cabinet on 10th June 2024 resolved to provide assistance to 3 crore additional rural and urban households for the construction of houses. Subsequently, on 9th August 2024, the Union Cabinet, chaired by the Hon'ble Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, approved Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban and Rural for the next 5 years. In pursuance of the Hon’ble Prime Minister’s vision, PMAY-U 2.0, will address the housing needs of 1 crore families, ensuring that every citizen leads a better quality of life. The Scheme will be implemented through following four verticals: • Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC) • Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP) • Affordable Rental Housing (ARH) • Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS) PMAY-U 2.0 will achieve the vision of ‘Housing for All’ by fulfilling the housing dreams of EWS/LIG/MIG segments. The Scheme will also ensure equity across different segments of population by addressing the requirement of slum dwellers, SC/STs, minorities, widows, Persons with Disabilities and other underprivileged sections of the society. Background 7 All Statutory Towns as per Census 2011 and towns notified subsequently and areas falling within the boundary of Notified Planning Areas, Notified Planning/Development area under the jurisdiction of Industrial Development Authority/Special Area Development Authority/Urban Development Authority or any such Authority under State legislation which is entrusted with the functions of urban planning and regulations shall be included for the coverage under the Scheme for all verticals. The Cities/Towns and areas falling under Notified Planning Areas, Notified Planning/Development area under the jurisdiction of Industrial Development Authority/Special Area Development Authority/Urban Development Authority or any such Authority, where PMAY-U is being implemented will continue to be covered under PMAY-U 2.0. Cities/towns which were not part of PMAY-U may also be included in PMAY-U 2.0 with due approval of MoHUA. Coverage 8 Families belonging to EWS/LIG/MIG category, living in urban areas, having no pucca house anywhere in the country, are eligible to purchase or construct a house under PMAY-U 2.0. A beneficiary will be eligible for availing benefit under any one vertical of the scheme. The beneficiary who has been allotted house under any of the housing scheme of Central Government, State/UT Government and Local Self Government in last 20 years in urban or rural areas, shall not be eligible to seek benefit under PMAY-U 2.0. An undertaking may also be submitted by the beneficiary while validating the demand by ULB in this regard. EWS households are defined as households with an annual income of up to ₹3 lakh; LIG as households with an annual income from ₹3 lakh up to ₹6 lakh; and MIG as households with an annual income from ₹6 lakh up to ₹9 lakh. States/UTs shall have the flexibility to redefine the annual income criteria of EWS as per prevailing conditions with concurrence of MoHUA. Preference under the Scheme will be given to Widows, single women, Persons with Disabilities, Senior Citizens, Transgenders, persons belonging to Scheduled Castes/ Scheduled Tribes, Minorities and other weaker and vulnerable sections of the society. Special focus will be given to Safai Karmi, Street Vendors identified under PMSVANidhi Scheme and different artisans under Pradhan Mantri- Vishwakarma Scheme, Anganwadi workers, building and other construction workers, residents of slums/chawls and other groups identified during operation of PMAY-U 2.0. It would also be ensured that if a pucca house has been provided to the parents of any eligible beneficiary under the previous housing schemes then, he/she will be considered only after other eligible families/beneficiaries whose parents have not availed any benefit under the previous housing schemes are included in the list of beneficiaries. Eligibility Criteria 9 The houses sanctioned under PMAY-U which got curtailed by Central Sanctioning and Monitoring Committee (CSMC) after 31.12.2023 due to any reason on the recommendation of States/UTs, shall not be sanctioned in PMAY-U 2.0 to those beneficiaries. The beneficiaries may avail benefit in PMAY-Gramin or PMAY-U 2.0 as per their jurisdiction. The MIS linkage between Department of Rural Development for PMAY-G and MoHUA for PMAY-U 2.0 would be done to avoid duplication of beneficiaries. The final list of beneficiaries may be checked and verified by States/UTs/ULBs before sending to the CSMC for sanctioning. All eligible beneficiaries (including family members) should have an Aadhaar/ Aadhaar Virtual ID integrated with the details of beneficiaries. In case, any eligible beneficiary does not have an Aadhaar card/Aadhaar Virtual ID, States/UTs should ensure that Aadhaar/Aadhaar Virtual ID enrolment of such beneficiary is done on priority. 10 Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC) Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP) Affordable Rental Housing (ARH) Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS) PMAY-U 2.0 Verticals • EWS beneficiary to purchase/avail allotted houses in Apartment projects by public/ private sector agencies/ parastatal agencies • Redeemable Housing Vouchers for purchase of houses in whitelisted private sector projects • Various State Incentives to public/private projects • In-Situ Slum Redevelopment of tenable Slums or Slum Resettlement • Benefits of subsidy on home loans for EWS/LIG and MIG families • Max. Loan value ₹25 lakh • Max. House Value ₹35 lakh • Loan subsidy of up to ₹1.80 lakh for EWS/LIG/MIG beneficiaries • 5-Yearly instalments • Affordable & dignified rental living spaces for urban dwellers • Model-1: Utilizing existing Government funded vacant houses by converting them into ARH under PPP mode or by public agencies. • Model-2: Construct, Operate and Maintain rental housing by Private/Public Entities for urban poor, working women, employees of Industries, Industrial Estates, Institutions and other eligible EWS/LIG families. • EWS beneficiary to construct house on own land • Provision of land patta/ rights to the landless by States/UTs • Geo-tag the construction stages of the house by beneficiaries. • Release of instalment is linked to construction stage • Free of cost statutory approvals, if needed • Upgradation of Tenable Slums with housing and infrastructure Flowchart depicting steps in BLC component Flowchart depicting steps in AHP component (Public sector) 13 Flowchart depicting steps in AHP component (Private sector) 14 14 Flowchart depicting steps in ISS component 15 15 The PMAY-U 2.0 website is designed and developed for filing of applications, record keeping, tracking of applications, monitoring, documentation and knowledge sharing among the stakeholders at the National, State/UT/ULB level. The web portal can also be accessed by parastatals, implementing agencies, and other public/private entities. The PMAY-U 2.0 website can be accessed at https://pmaymis.gov.in/pmaymis2_2024/pmaydefault.aspx . Users can find a wide range of information on the website, including details about the PMAY-U 2.0 mission, operational guidelines, progress of the scheme, details regarding the four verticals, FAQs, latest updates and media coverage, as well as highlights from different events, including all photos and videos. The PMAY-U 2.0 website features a dedicated Management Information System (MIS) that facilitates user logins for stakeholders, including MoHUA, States/UTs/ULBs, and other implementing agencies. Additionally, the website provides facilities for public and private entities to register and submit applications for various components of the scheme. PMAY-U 2.0 MIS 16 Step 1: 1. Interested beneficiary who wants to own a house under PMAY-U 2.0 can register herself/himself on the PMAY-U 2.0 website, wherein it is required to click on ‘Apply for PMAY-U 2.0’ tab. 2. The system would then direct the user to PMAY-U 2.0 website. The webpage shows a menu bar with Seven buttons that helps the user navigate to take required action. 3. To register, the user can click on the 3rd button ‘Apply for PMAY-U 2.0.’ Applying for PMAY-U 2.0 17 Step 2: i. The system would successfully take the user to the Instruction of PMAY-U 2.0 page. ii. This page provides information about the four verticals under PMAY-U 2.0 along with annual income criteria for eligibility and permissible carpet area for each vertical. iii. The User is required to read and understand the instructions carefully, her/his eligibility criteria, the option to choose any one vertical out of the four verticals of PMAY-U 2,0 before availing the benefits. 18 Step 3: i. Users are required keep the necessary documents ready before proceeding further. ii. To go to the next page, click on the Proceed button. 19 Step 4: i. After proceeding, the User needs to undergo the eligibility check for the scheme. ii. User would not be Eligible for the schemes in cases: ▪ Annual Household Income is above ₹9,00,000 ▪ If the user owns a pucca house anywhere in India ▪ If they have availed benefit under any Housing scheme of Central/State/UT government in past 20 years. Eligibility for PMAY-U 2.0 20 Step 5: i. Once the Eligibility check is completed, the user shall give consent for Aadhaar authentication. ii. Users must enter their Aadhaar Number and Name exactly as provided in the Aadhaar card. iii. An OTP will be generated on the mobile number registered with the Aadhaar card. iv. Upon receiving the OTP, user shall enter the OTP and submit the same to complete the process. Note: A single Aadhar number can be used to fill only one form. Aadhar Authentication 21 FOR BLC FORM Step 6: User will then be taken to the Beneficiary Survey Form for all verticals. The survey form has different sections. i. Personal Details: In this section of the form, User’s Name, Aadhar and Preferred component that the User has already selected will be auto filled. The User needs to fill their other personal details manually. ii. In case of Married Female, Husband’s Aadhar details are mandatory. iii. Widow: Please select Late from the dropdown menu. iv. Deceased Father/Mother: Please select Late from the dropdown. Filling the Beneficiary Survey Form 22 PMAY-U 2.0 also aims to focus on special groups such as Safai Karmi, PMSVANidhi beneficiaries and different artisans under Pradhan Mantri-Vishwakarma Scheme, Anganwadi Workers, Building and other Construction Workers, slum dwellers/chawls etc. Preference will also be given to minority classes. Applicant can choose their category from dropdown. In case of Minority- SC/ST/OBC, the applicant needs to upload their caste certificate. v. At the bottom of the ‘Personal Details’ tab, Users who are beneficiaries of PM SVANidhi, different artisans under Pradhan Mantri-Vishwakarma Scheme, Anganwadi Workers, Building and other Construction Workers, slum dwellers/chawls etc. need to specify by clicking on checkbox and giving ID details where required. Priority will be given to them under Special Focus Group. vi. Details of Family Member The system will auto-fill family member details, based on the information provided in Personal details. User can review these details, make edits, or add other family members information as required. In case of Married Male, please specify details of the wife in this section. 23 vii. Household Details The system will automatically fill the Household Category, pucca house ownership and Average Annual Household Income. Users are required to upload Income certificate (pdf file less than 200 kb), select years of stay in the town/city, and fill in the house ownership details, such as own/rent/no house. Users are required to upload Income certificate (pdf file less than 200 kb), select 32 years of stay in the town/city, and fill the house ownership details, such as own/rent/no house. Then mention the type of house-Kutcha/semi-pucca/pucca; then select the type of roof from dropdown. • Address Users also need to give their Present Address/ Permanent Address/ and Construction site address. Users need to enter the Project Location details. 33 • Home Loan Details In the ISS Component, Users must provide Home Loan Details. If the User has already availed a Home Loan, select Yes and enter the required details. Click on save & continue. 34 • Bank Details Users must enter their bank account number, and IFSC code to generate Bank details. 35 Submitting the Survey Form On the final page, check the acknowledgment box to confirm the accuracy of the information provided and click on the Final Save button to submit the form. # [पत्र सूचना कार्यालय](/index.aspx "Press Information Bureau")

![Press Information Bureau](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/photo/2024/jun/ph2024624343601.jpg "Press Information Bureau")

## PMAY-Urban 2.0

### Closing the Urban Housing Divide with Angikaar 2025

**Key Takeaways**

**Angikaar 2025 Is Here: Accelerating the Last-Mile Delivery of Urban Housing**

![Angikaar 2.0 Banner_New.jpg](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/userfiles/image/image00313SR.jpg)

![Angikaar 2.0 Banner_New.jpg](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/userfiles/image/image00313SR.jpg)

*Imagine having the**opportunity to build a safe, permanent home for your family, made possible through a**government scheme. Would you take it?*

Right now, thousands of families across towns and cities in India are turning this opportunity into reality.

From **September 4 to October 31, 2025**, the government has launched a bold nationwide campaign called **Angikaar 2025**, a mission that’s bringing the promise of **"Housing for All"** directly to people’s doorsteps. Backed by **PMAY-Urban 2.0**, this is not just a policy push. It’s a **people’s movement**, one that blends awareness, accountability, and action in equal measure.

Whether it’s guiding families through their application process, speeding up the construction of long-awaited homes, or connecting them with solar power and loan support, **Angikaar is about reaching the unreached and including the excluded**.

Because for millions of urban poor, the real question isn’t “How many homes have been built?”

It's "When will mine be ready?"

![](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/userfiles/image/image004DKFI.png)

![](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/userfiles/image/image004DKFI.png)

**Angikaar 2025** is India’s most direct answer yet.

When **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban)** was launched in 2015, it carried with it a bold promise— **“Housing for All”**. Over the years, it has transformed lives by enabling millions of low-income families in cities to move into **safe, permanent, and affordable homes**. Building on this foundation, **PMAY-Urban 2.0** was launched in September 2024. Its mission is simple yet powerful: **leave no family behind**. Every urban household, regardless of background, must have not just a roof, but a **secure home with access to basic services**.

|  |
| --- |
| On 17th September 2025, a nationwide celebration will mark the one-year anniversary of PMAY-Urban 2.0, observed across all States, UTs, Districts, and Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) as PMAY-U Awas Diwas. |

On 17th September 2025, a nationwide celebration will mark the one-year anniversary of PMAY-Urban 2.0, observed across all States, UTs, Districts, and Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) as PMAY-U Awas Diwas.

![WhatsApp Image 2025-08-22 at 11.52.12 AM.jpeg](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/userfiles/image/image0063NG3.jpg)

![WhatsApp Image 2025-08-22 at 11.52.12 AM.jpeg](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/userfiles/image/image0063NG3.jpg)

**Driving Urban Housing Saturation, Speed, and Inclusion**

At its core, Angikaar 2025 is a mission-driven campaign designed to ensure full saturation of the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban (PMAY-U) 2.0 scheme across India’s urban landscape, with the following major objectives :

|  |
| --- |
| * Speeding up the completion of **20 lakh houses** already sanctioned under PMAY-U. * Including potential beneficiaries from **Special Focus Groups** such as **safai karamcharis**, **street vendors** (under **PM SVANidhi**), **artisans** (under **PM Vishwakarma**), **Anganwadi workers**, **construction workers**, and residents of **slums and chawls**. * Conducting a **special drive** to extend **PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana** benefits to homes that are already built. * Facilitating **Grih Pravesh ceremonies** for newly completed houses to ensure dignified handovers. * Disseminating information on all verticals of the scheme and helping beneficiaries navigate the **Unified Web Portal** of PMAY-U 2.0 for application and tracking. * Verifying applicant eligibility through intensive **field-level mobilization**, **document checks**, **geo-tagging**, and **door-to-door engagement**. * Supporting **home loan facilitation** for the **8.5 lakh** houses already sanctioned under the scheme. * Celebrating **September and October 2025 as ‘Housing Months’**, marking a nationwide push for visibility, delivery, and community involvement. |

**PM Awas Mela – Shehri: Celebrating One Year of PMAY-U 2.0**

To bring these goals to life and deepen community engagement, the Angikaar 2025 campaign includes a flagship event that acts as a catalyst for awareness, implementation, and inclusion. This event mobilizes stakeholders at every level, from government agencies and financial institutions to local communities, to accelerate housing delivery and ensure beneficiaries receive comprehensive support and information.

 The flagship event of Angikaar 2025, “PM Awas Mela – Shehri,” will take place from 17th to 27th September 2025, serving as a dynamic platform to highlight the benefits of PMAY-U and PMAY-U 2.0, while fostering convergence and community participation at the grassroots level. The event will run in two phases: the first from 17th to 27th September, and the second on any day between 15th and 31st October 2025.

![Home_4.jpg](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/userfiles/image/image007EJRS.jpg)

![Home_4.jpg](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/userfiles/image/image007EJRS.jpg)

|  |
| --- |
| **PM Awas Mela – Shehri will offer a variety of services focused on prospective PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiaries, including:**  •Help desks and information kiosks providing guidance on eligibility, application procedures, and scheme benefits.  • On-the-spot verification and registration.  • PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana camps to extend benefits to current PMAY-U beneficiaries.  • Loan Melas facilitating easy access to home loans for beneficiaries of PMAY-U, PMAY-U 2.0, and the solar electricity scheme.  • Health camps and camps for other welfare schemes such as PM Ujjwala, PM SVANidhi, and Ayushman Bharat, promoting scheme convergence.  • Dedicated camps for Special Focus Groups under PMAY-U 2.0.  • Enrollment drives for potential beneficiaries based on camp interactions.  • Engaging activities like quizzes, selfie booths, and cultural performances by local artists and students.  • Sharing of beneficiary success stories to inspire and motivate others.  • Felicitations for outstanding beneficiaries, women achievers, and student performers.  • Celebrations recognizing achievements of Urban Local Bodies.  • Extensive media coverage to highlight the event’s activities. |

**PM Awas Mela – Shehri will offer a variety of services focused on prospective PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiaries, including:**

•Help desks and information kiosks providing guidance on eligibility, application procedures, and scheme benefits.  
• On-the-spot verification and registration.  
• PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana camps to extend benefits to current PMAY-U beneficiaries.  
• Loan Melas facilitating easy access to home loans for beneficiaries of PMAY-U, PMAY-U 2.0, and the solar electricity scheme.  
• Health camps and camps for other welfare schemes such as PM Ujjwala, PM SVANidhi, and Ayushman Bharat, promoting scheme convergence.  
• Dedicated camps for Special Focus Groups under PMAY-U 2.0.  
• Enrollment drives for potential beneficiaries based on camp interactions.  
• Engaging activities like quizzes, selfie booths, and cultural performances by local artists and students.  
• Sharing of beneficiary success stories to inspire and motivate others.  
• Felicitations for outstanding beneficiaries, women achievers, and student performers.  
• Celebrations recognizing achievements of Urban Local Bodies.  
• Extensive media coverage to highlight the event’s activities.

**Expanding the Reach of Housing**

![WhatsApp Image 2025-09-16 at 12.48.57 PM.jpeg](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/userfiles/image/image008RMD7.jpg)

![WhatsApp Image 2025-09-16 at 12.48.57 PM.jpeg](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/userfiles/image/image008RMD7.jpg)

Since inception, PMAY has sanctioned **over 1.2 crore houses**, of which nearly **94 lakh homes have already been handed over**. With PMAY-Urban 2.0, the government has pledged **support for one crore more urban families**.

Eligible households from EWS, LIG, and MIG categories can receive up to **₹2.5 lakh in financial assistance** to build or buy their own home. Applications can be filed online at **pmay-urban.gov.in** or through local ULBs.

|  |
| --- |
| At the **4th Central Sanctioning and Monitoring Committee (CSMC) meeting** in August 2025, an additional **1.47 lakh pucca houses were approved** across 14 States and UTs—taking the total to **8.56 lakh under PMAY-U 2.0**. |

At the **4th Central Sanctioning and Monitoring Committee (CSMC) meeting** in August 2025, an additional **1.47 lakh pucca houses were approved** across 14 States and UTs—taking the total to **8.56 lakh under PMAY-U 2.0**.

**How PMAY-U 2.0 Works**

PMAY-U 2.0 is being implemented through four verticals – Beneficiary-Led Construction (BLC), Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP), Affordable Rental Housing (ARH), and the Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS). Most of the homes approved recently fall under the BLC and AHP components. Through this ongoing effort, the government continues to support inclusive urban growth, with the goal of ensuring that every family has not just a house, but a safe and dignified home.

![IMG_3786.JPG](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/userfiles/image/image009QY0G.jpg)

![IMG_3786.JPG](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/userfiles/image/image009QY0G.jpg)

**Who Is Eligible?**

|  |
| --- |
| * Families (husband, wife, unmarried sons/daughters) with no pucca house anywhere in India. * Belonging to **EWS (≤ ₹3 lakh), LIG (₹3–6 lakh), MIG (₹6–9 lakh)** categories. * Priority given to **widows, single women, senior citizens, transgenders, SC/ST/OBC households, minorities, safai karamcharis, street vendors, artisans, Anganwadi and construction workers, and slum dwellers.** * Aadhaar/Virtual ID mandatory for all applicants. * Duplication avoided through **linkage with PMAY-G** (rural counterpart). |

Below is a state‑and‑UT‑wise snapshot of how many pucca homes have already been completed under **PMAY‑U & PMAY‑2.0**, illustrating concrete progress toward eligibility translating into actual delivery across urban India.

**![IMG_3788.PNG](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/userfiles/image/image010CMSQ.png)**

![IMG_3788.PNG](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/userfiles/image/image010CMSQ.png)

**int of change: Enablers of Transformation**

**Equality Begins at Home**

A key focus of the ongoing implementation of PMAY-Urban 2.0 has been on promoting inclusivity and empowering vulnerable sections of society. As of August 2025-

Building on this commitment to support marginalized groups, the following numbers of houses have been sanctioned for various underprivileged communities:

· **32,551** for Scheduled Castes (SC),

· **5,025** for Scheduled Tribes (ST), and

· **58,375** for Other Backward Classes (OBC) — ensuring that assistance reaches those who have historically faced social and economic disadvantages.

**Conclusion: Towards Timely and Targeted Housing for All**

PMAY-Urban 2.0, along with the Angikaar campaign, represents a powerful commitment by the Government of India to inclusive development. PMAY-U 2.0 provides the foundation of dignified housing, while Angikaar complements it by integrating beneficiaries with essential services such as sanitation, healthcare, education, and financial inclusion. Together, they ensure that every home is a source of stability, opportunity, and dignity. With timely implementation, inclusivity at its core, and a convergence-driven approach, India is advancing steadily toward the vision of Housing for All. Each home built empowers a life, and every family included brings the nation closer to a future grounded in equity, justice, and sustainable growth.

## Cabinet approves continuation of Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban (PMAY-U) - “Housing for All” Mission up to 31st December 2024.

### Govt of India has accepted the request of States/UTs for more time for completion of houses. Financial assistance is being provided for the construction of 122.69 lakh sanctioned houses under the scheme

The Union Cabinet, chaired by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, today has approved the proposal of Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) for continuation of Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban (PMAY-U) up to 31stDecember 2024 wherein financial assistance is to be provided for the completion of already sanctioned 122.69 lakh houses till 31stMarch 2022.

PMAY-U: Housing for All is one of the major flagship programmes being implemented by Government of India to provide all weather pucca houses to all eligible beneficiaries in the urban areas of the country through States/UTs/Central Nodal Agencies. The scheme covers the entire urban area of the country, i.e., all statutory towns as per Census 2011 and towns notified subsequently, including Notified Planning/ Development Areas. The scheme is being implemented through four verticals: Beneficiary Led Construction/ Enhancement (BLC), Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP), In-situ Slum Redevelopment (ISSR) and Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS). While Govt of India provides financial assistance, State Govt/UTs implement the scheme including selection of beneficiaries.

During the period of 2004-2014, 8.04 lakh houses were completed under Urban Housing Scheme. Under the Modi Govt, the issue of providing houses to all eligible Urban dwellers in saturation mode was brought into focus and the scheme of PMAY-Urban was conceptualised. # Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS)

Under the Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS) vertical of PMAY-U 2.0, subsidy is provided on home loans
sanctioned and disbursed on 01.09.2024 or after to eligible beneficiaries of EWS/LIG/MIG segments
for purchase/repurchase/construction of houses. Households belonging to EWS, LIG and MIG
categories, with an annual income of up to ₹3 lakh, ₹6 lakh and ₹9 lakh, respectively will be eligible
to avail the benefit of the Scheme.

A maximum release of interest subsidy of ₹1.80 lakh having maximum NPV of ₹1.50 shall be
provided to eligible beneficiaries having a loan tenure of more than five years. Households having
income up to ₹9 lakh, loan value up to ₹25 lakh for property value up to ₹35 lakh would be eligible
for a subsidy at 4.0 % on first ₹8 lakh for a tenure up to 12 years. The maximum carpet area of
houses under this component shall be up to 120 sqm.

For availing the benefit under ISS vertical, eligible beneficiaries will be required to register their
demand through Unified Web Portal. Subsequently, the application will be forwarded to the
concerned PLIs for further necessary action as per his/her eligibility criteria.

Subsidy will be released in 5-yearly instalments through DBT in loan accounts of beneficiaries,
provided loan is active at the time of release of subsidy and more than 50% principal is outstanding.
Subsidy will be credited by the PLI to the borrower’s account upfront by deducting it from the
principal loan amount of the borrower. The borrower will pay EMI as per lending rates on the
remainder of the principal loan amount.

Geo-tagging of houses along with their geo-spatial location is required to be done by the respective
PLI/beneficiary as per the payment plan.
